title: Boiler Gauge

reward.description: A brass dial with a cracked glass face. The needle still twitches when you breathe on it.

hints: Multiply psi by 0.0689476 to get bar, then use round(value, 2).
Check the error case first: if psi < 0, raise ValueError("pressure can't be negative").
Order your if/elif from smallest to largest pressure so each branch only needs one comparison.
